definition: Sudip Roy is a computer scientist and technology executive.
details: He is the co-founder and chief technology officer of Adaption. He has worked on large-scale machine learning systems at organizations including Google DeepMind and Cohere.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. And that idea, made concrete, is Sudip Roy (computer scientist).
